Our Coaching Process

Five steps, shaped around your goals and daily routine. Results differ from person to person.

  1. Free Consultation

    Understand goals, lifestyle, food preferences and relevant health considerations.

  2. Personalized Diet Plan

    Create a practical plan according to individual needs and routine.

  3. Exercise & Lifestyle Guidance

    Provide suitable activity and daily habit guidance.

  4. Regular Follow-Up

    Review progress and adjust the plan when appropriate.

  5. Long-Term Maintenance

    Help clients build sustainable habits and work toward maintaining progress.

About Us — Vajan.fit

Vajan.fit is a weight management and lifestyle coaching brand dedicated to helping people develop healthier, more sustainable habits. We focus on personalized guidance, practical meal planning, homemade Indian foods, balanced nutrition and everyday lifestyle improvements.

Our goal is to make healthy living practical for real people with busy schedules, family responsibilities and different food preferences. We believe that long-term progress requires more than a short-term diet. It requires education, consistency, personal support and habits that people can realistically maintain.

Our services include personalized nutrition guidance, Indian meal planning, lifestyle coaching, online support, progress tracking and weight-maintenance guidance.

Real Experience. Practical Guidance. Sustainable Habits.

Meet Our Founders

Jitendra Govind Gaur

Founder, Vajan.fit | Weight Management Coach

“I understand the struggle because I have lived it.”

My weight-management journey started with my own struggle. At my heaviest, I weighed approximately 136 kg. I experienced the practical and emotional challenges associated with excess weight, including low confidence, difficulty with everyday activities and the impact of other people’s comments.

Instead of relying only on temporary solutions, I began learning about nutrition, food habits and practical lifestyle changes. I worked on improving my eating habits and understanding how homemade Indian food could fit into a more balanced routine.

Through my personal journey, I reduced my weight from approximately 136 kg to 80–85 kg. My experience taught me that weight management is not simply about losing weight; building sustainable habits and maintaining progress are equally important.

After my own transformation, I supported my wife, Diksha, in her weight-management journey. Seeing these challenges firsthand helped us understand how important practical guidance, patience and ongoing support can be.

This experience inspired us to build Vajan.fit, with the aim of helping other people approach weight management through realistic food choices, education and personalized support.

My Mission: To help people understand their bodies, improve their everyday habits and work toward healthier, sustainable lifestyles.

Diksha Ma’am

Co-Founder, Vajan.fit

“My personal journey helped me understand the importance of patience, knowledge and consistent habits.”

In January 2021, following pregnancy, Diksha’s weight reached approximately 90 kg. She decided to take a more informed approach to her health by learning about nutrition, reviewing food choices and making structured changes to her daily eating habits.

During 2021, she worked consistently on her weight-management journey and reported losing approximately 40 kg over the course of the year. She continued focusing on maintaining her progress, and her experience through 2026 strengthened her understanding of the challenges involved in long-term weight management.

After her own journey, Diksha also supported Jitendra in his transformation. These shared experiences helped them recognize that every person’s circumstances, challenges and needs are different.

Her personal experience became one of the inspirations behind Vajan.fit. As Co-Founder, she contributes to the brand’s mission of offering practical guidance, encouragement and sustainable lifestyle support to people working toward their health goals.

Her Mission: To help people feel supported, informed and confident while developing healthier habits.

Fasting Education & Personal Training

Learn Fasting With Personal Guidance

An educational program that explains different fasting approaches, how they work, and the considerations involved in choosing an appropriate routine. Participants receive guided instruction rather than being encouraged to copy fasting routines without understanding them.

Learn More
  • Education about different fasting approaches
  • Personal guidance and training
  • Understanding hydration and nutrition
  • Recognizing when fasting may be unsuitable
  • Guidance on building safe, sustainable habits

Safety message: Fasting is not appropriate for everyone. People with medical conditions, those taking certain medications, pregnant or breastfeeding people, and anyone at risk of nutritional deficiencies should seek appropriate professional advice before attempting fasting.

Our Books & Products

Published

वजन का सच

Author: जितेंद्र गोविंद गौड़

वजन घटाने से पहले वजन का सच जानिए।

“वजन का सच” is a Hindi book about understanding weight management through practical knowledge, Indian food culture and everyday habits. It aims to help readers look beyond quick-fix dieting and understand the importance of informed food choices, consistency and sustainable lifestyle changes.

The book discusses common misunderstandings about weight, practical approaches to healthy habits and the role of familiar Indian foods in everyday nutrition.

Order Our Books
Published

मैंने अपनी ज़िंदगी बदल दी

Author: जितेंद्र गोविंद गौड़

“मैंने अपनी ज़िंदगी बदल दी” shares the author’s personal transformation story, including the challenges of living with excess weight, the emotional impact of weight-related comments, the decision to change daily habits and the lessons learned through the journey.

It is a motivational story about persistence, self-awareness, discipline and making practical changes. The book aims to encourage readers to take their own next step toward healthier habits.
